steps.message:
Fix complete and verified on the emulator.

## Root cause

`CollectActivity.TraitBox.currentTrait` is only assigned inside the trait spinner's `onItemSelected` callback. After importing only a *field* (`field_sample.csv`) with no traits in the database, `DataHelper.getVisibleTrait()` returns `null`, so `initWidgets()` skipped `initTraitType()` entirely — the spinner stayed empty, `onItemSelected` never fired, and `currentTrait` remained `null`.

Meanwhile, `activity_collect.xml` `<include>`s **all 15 trait layouts** and they are visible by default (they are only hidden inside `onItemSelected` → `traitLayouts.hideLayouts()`, which never ran). So the Collect screen rendered every trait widget stacked up, and tapping any of them (e.g. counter's `+1`) dereferenced the null trait → `NullPointerException` at `CounterTraitLayout$1.onClick`. The same applied to the NA / delete buttons and the trait arrows.

## Changes

**`CollectActivity.java`**
- `loadScreen()`: `traitLayouts.hideLayouts()` right after constructing them — no trait layout is interactive until a trait is actually selected.
- `initWidgets()`: treat empty/`null` trait lists explicitly — clear the trait box, hide all layouts, hide/disable `etCurVal`, disable the NA/delete buttons, and toast the existing `warning_traits_missing` string (once). Re-enables the buttons when traits exist and data isn't locked.
- New `TraitBox.clear()` resets `currentTrait`, the spinner adapter, and the details text.
- Null guards where `currentTrait` was dereferenced: `validateData()`, `setNaText()`, `setNaTextBrapiEmptyField()`, NA/delete listeners, `brapiDelete()`, `removeTrait(String)`, `removeTrait()`, `existsTrait(int)`, `TraitBox.getCurrentFormat()`, `TraitBox.existsTrait()`, `TraitBox.moveTrait()` (no-op with an empty spinner), and `getSelectedItemPosition()` (clamps `INVALID_POSITION` to 0).
- `createSummaryText()`: guards against null `prefixTraits` / `getAllTraits()` / empty dropdown range (fixes the `//TODO this test crashes app` case).

**`BaseTraitLayout.java`** — added `isTraitSelected()` helper for layouts.

**`CounterTraitLayout.java`** — `+1` / `-1` listeners, `loadLayout()`, and `deleteTraitListener()` now bail out when no trait is selected (removed the two `//TODO NullPointerException` markers).

## Verification

`./gradlew clean assembleDebug` → BUILD SUCCESSFUL. Then on a running emulator I replayed the exact repro: permissions → "No" to both dialogs → Fields → import `field_sample.csv` (200 plots) → Collect. The Collect screen now shows an empty trait area instead of stacked widgets; tapping every button (trait arrows, spinner, entry arrows, NA, delete, and the former `+1`/`-1` region) produced **no crash** and no `NullPointerException` in logcat.

Regression check: created a Counter trait `cnt`, reopened Collect — layout renders normally, three `+1` and one `-1` gave `2`, NA/delete and entry navigation all work, counter resets to `0` on the next plot.
